title: Doorimte gano abeenitik
intro: Aydaadul, qibaadah farmoytit sahdayti baxi fanat gexak sugteeh, keenik xayih yan mari ifu yaaxigeenim maduudan. Tama akkaawonti namma roocih addat mermeritaah, ken nabiyyih xaynal ken aqayyaare tekkeeh, ken legacy wakti sinni baritto kinni.
clues: Nanu kaxxa farmoytit waktil mannowne, uxih ni intiita oson baahen nummat alfimteh sugte.
Ni buxaaxi qibaadah maybalaalaqak kibbimteh sugte, takkay immay ni sorkocô baxi maqarrowteh.
Nanu ken ummatta takkaawisoonuh dooreenih yanin marat digibneh sugne.
digaala temeete wak, nanu doonik addat reebuk magorrisnaay, cararta roobuk makudna, kah kinnim nanu maabitina anqasak sugne.
Nanu Qur'aanak ceelalloh edde yabneh nan, nabiyyi luk xayi angaaraw takkay immay, cato mali.
Nanu Nuuc kee Luutut barra kinnino, ken gano abteeh, tohih taagah ken nackume.

trial.label: Ken gibbatu macak sugteeh?
options: oson farmoytit digibeenih yenen takkay immay kufriteenih
Oson xalay sugeenim kee farmoytit esserimen
Oson gaddali kee kaxxiina luk sugen
Iblis ken aqayyaareenih sinni buxaaxi cabaanamal ken aqayyaareh aben .
trial.answer: oson farmoytit digibeenih yenen takkay immay kufriteenih

outcome.label: Keenik illacabo macak sugteeh?
options: oson damaaqe kee ceray fan milaagimeenih

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
